verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Stripe documents an official MCP server at docs.stripe.com/mcp, so an agent can connect to Stripe through a first-party MCP endpoint. The evidence does not show that this platform-wide server exposes Stripe Tax functions such as calculations, transactions or registrations. Missing for 10: evidence that Tax-specific operations are exposed as MCP tools, setup/auth details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
